finalText:
I wrote the launch email to `outputs/email.txt` (118 words by `wc`, under the 120 limit). My choices are in `notes.md`.

The skill asks for both the headline and the product name and version to come first. I put the Subject line first, then opened the body with "Ferry 3.5: Six ways to fill a quiet week." so all three appear together. The release date line gives only the date from the brief, 9 June 2027. Check whether you want wording like "available from" added.
